divert25.title: On the pad: gyro and pad calibration
divert25.text: flight.py is a state machine: PAD, READY, SPOOL, CLIMB, TRANSIT, HOVER, DESCENT, FINAL, TOUCHDOWN. It calibrates the sensors on the pad first; the camera orbits the vehicle.

divert25.title: SPOOL: the EDF comes up
divert25.text: Thrust is raised up to 1.12 times the weight until the legs leave the ground. Four jet vanes in the exhaust steer the vehicle.

divert25.title: Liftoff, slow motion
divert25.text: Slow motion 1/3. The attitude loop commands torque, the vane allocation turns that into four servo angles, deflecting the fan exhaust.

divert25.title: CLIMB to 25 m
divert25.text: Minimum-jerk vertical leg, 4x speed. The controller works from the estimator (IMU, barometer, GNSS, lidar), not from the simulator truth.

divert25.title: TRANSIT: 8 m east, 6 m north
divert25.text: The divert to the second pad, 2x speed, in a light breeze with Dryden turbulence. Wide camera pan; the trail and pad markings are drawn by the video tool only.

divert25.title: HOVER over the second pad
divert25.text: The pad is only a point in the GNSS frame: the precision comes from the RTK receiver. Real time.

divert25.title: DESCENT
divert25.text: 4x speed. A controlled sink down to about 2 m above the pad, where FINAL takes over.

divert25.title: FINAL approach
divert25.text: Lidar-governed final: slow vertical speed, position held over the pad centre.

divert25.title: TOUCHDOWN, slow motion
divert25.text: Slow motion 1/3. This run lands 5 cm from the pad centre at 0.18 m/s; the kernel's monitors judge speed, tilt and distance, not the video.

gusts.title: Same vehicle, same flight code
gusts.text: Spool and liftoff at 2x. A 5 m/s steady wind with Dryden gusts blows the whole flight.

gusts.title: CLIMB to 15 m in wind
gusts.text: 4x speed. The vehicle leans into the wind: note the tilt on the HUD.

gusts.title: A vane servo goes soft at 14 s
gusts.text: One servo (drawn from the seed) loses 65 % of its torque and half its stiffness; 3 s later the pack voltage steps down 1.5 V. The flight software is not told.

gusts.title: Transit, hover, descent
gusts.text: 4x speed. Vane saturation shows on the HUD; the controller keeps the position.

gusts.title: Touchdown on the second pad
gusts.text: Slow motion 1/2. This seed lands: the Monte Carlo of this mission passes 87.5 % of held-out seeds, and the rest is shown on the results card.
